name: Jungle horrors

variantInfo.name: Jungle horror
notes: Five functionally identical appearance variants (Worker, Young worker, Warrior, Young warrior, Guard) all count.
Aggressive stab attacker with a 4-tick attack speed and a max hit of 8.

locationComparison.name: Mos Le'Harmless
notes: Roughly 50 Jungle horror spawns across the island surface; the largest camp holds 10-12 north of the cave exit.
Multiple safespots are available using walls, plants, and trees.
Multicombat and cannon-placement status of the island surface are not stated on the wiki pages fetched at authoring time.

taskNotes: Jungle horrors require 65 combat and completion of Cabin Fever; there is no Slayer level requirement.
Jungle horrors roam the Mos Le'Harmless island surface, not the Mos Le'Harmless Cave (that cave holds Cave horrors).
The task is assigned by Vannaka (40-90, weight 8) and Chaeldar (70-130, weight 10) and is not extendable.
Jungle horrors have a 25% elemental weakness to fire spells.
They drop pineapples frequently; bringing a knife lets the drops be sliced for food to extend trips.
Players under 70 Defence should bring food and decent armour; safespots behind walls, plants, and trees avoid damage entirely.

slayerTargetId 250 is a SYNTHETIC placeholder (240 + WC index 10, team contract 2026-07-02, Frost-Dragons precedent); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value for Jungle horrors is not wiki-published, so varp-based detection falls back to the task-name path.
recommendedMethod: Melee them with your best weapon, or pick them off from wall, plant, and tree safespots; fire spells exploit their 25% elemental weakness. Slice dropped pineapples with a knife for free food.
